subject: planner: out of range col stats only if loaded (#64582)
summary: Diff is limited to `pkg/planner/cardinality/row_count_index.go`, adding `c.Histogram.Len() > 0` before using column histogram out-of-range estimation for single-column ranges in StatsV2; otherwise it falls back to index histogram out-of-range estimation. This avoids silently getting `DefaultRowEst(0)` from `Histogram.OutOfRangeRowCount()` when the column histogram buckets are not loaded (Len==0), improving CE without affecting query semantics. Looked at later history on `upstream/master` touching this file; no follow-up indicates a correctness/runtime fix was needed for this change.
